name: stalwart-mail
description: Mail and contacts on your own Stalwart server: search, read (attachments and scans too), reply, send, drafts.

server_url.title: Server address
server_url.description: Public address of your Stalwart server, e.g. https://mail.example.com

email.title: Mailbox e-mail
email.description: The full address you sign in with

password.title: Mailbox password
password.description: The mailbox password or an app password

language.title: Language
language.description: auto, en, cs, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt or sk

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: true or false. With false Claude can prepare drafts but cannot send mail.

ocr_provider.title: OCR provider
ocr_provider.description: Who reads scanned attachments: off, mistral, anthropic, openai, openrouter, gemini, ollama, lmstudio or custom

ocr_api_key.title: OCR API key
ocr_api_key.description: API key of the OCR provider; not needed for local servers

ocr_model.title: OCR model
ocr_model.description: Model name; empty = the provider's default where there is one

ocr_base_url.title: OCR server address
ocr_base_url.description: Only for a custom or non-default OCR server
